scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.dev:v2: concurrently "npm run dev:gateway" "npm run dev:auth" "npm run dev:tourism" "npm run dev:booking" "npm run dev:notification" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.db:generate: npm run db:generate --workspace=services/auth-service && npm run db:generate --workspace=services/tourism-service && npm run db:generate --workspace=services/booking-payment-service
scripts.db:migrate: npm run db:migrate --workspace=services/auth-service && npm run db:migrate --workspace=services/tourism-service && npm run db:migrate --workspace=services/booking-payment-service
scripts.db:seed: npm run db:seed --workspace=services/auth-service && npm run db:seed --workspace=services/tourism-service
